platform.name: StoryFlow AI
platform.mission: Help human teams turn AI-generated work into credible, reviewable, well-organized results.
platform.primary_goal: Provide an internal, human-directed workspace for reviewing AI-generated content, connecting it to goals and milestones, and planning approved publication and follow-up.
principles: AI completion is never the same as human approval.
Keep real and staged inputs clearly distinguishable.
Do not schedule unapproved drafts or send messages without review.
Never invent results, endorsements, data rights, or outcomes.
planned_workflow: Analyze goals, themes, content, and suggested replies
Human verifies quality, accuracy, brand fit, and permissions
Track actions and outcomes separately from targets
